copy.blurb: The honest read on Colombia versus DR Congo is that there's no edge here: the model and The Market sit a point apart at most, on every side. Manufacturing a disagreement out of that — talking up a tenth of a point as though it meant something — is the one thing this desk won't do. The model's numbers (69% / 15% / 16%) line up with the market's, and a verdict that admits as much is worth more than a forced call. Pass means exactly what it says: we looked, the price is fair, there's nothing to add today. We'll look again when there's something new to weigh.
